frame.title: Cassetta frame
frame.credit: The Metropolitan Museum of Art, Robert Lehman Collection, 1975
frame.rights: The Met Open Access, CC0; metadata isPublicDomain=true
frame.treatment: Original archival photograph retained locally. Before the intro clock starts, eight photographic crops and a warm gold color transfer are cached as a transparent 2000x1600 runtime Canvas bitmap. One SVG image with a polygon clip reveals the real moulding and corner photographs.

engraving.surface: Bare white workspace directly below the painting; no plaque or colored backing
engraving.treatment: Original plaster photograph retained locally. Neutralized photo grain and shallow cut shading are cached inside the letter shapes in a transparent 1440x192 runtime Canvas bitmap. One active-letter SVG stroke mask and completed-letter clip reveal the cuts. No rectangular substrate is rendered. Contact, sparks and a faint ablation wisp remain live SVG.
engraving.lettering: Fixed inscription outlines from the existing local Inter 500 font; build with scripts/guide-intro/build-engraving.py (fontTools). No new runtime font or npm dependency.
